source: Direct user instruction in CFA task
role: Codex keeps the methodology and established aesthetic decisions; Grok executes the work.
authorizedActions: Read current Grok conversation when checking ongoing work.
Ask Grok focused questions about missing references, manifests, counts and defects.
Send routine corrections back to the user-established brief without reconfirming each time.
Prepare and request bounded corrective work within the existing authorized task.
Record sent messages, provider responses and actual received/verified evidence.
decisionAuthority: The user remains authority for new aesthetic decisions and acceptance of a new master.
scopeLimits: Do not infer authorization for purchases, expanded budgets, unlimited rerolls or public release.
Do not initiate an unrelated character/project or silently change agreed creative direction.
Conditional permission to intervene is not a claim of continuous background monitoring.
